reason: I already downloaded a budget app and quit it after a few weeks because typing everything was a chore. This one fixes the typing part, but the iPhone Shortcut sounds like a setup project, and I doubt I would finish it in the 14-day trial, so I would probably never reach the 69 baht.
objection: If the Shortcut takes more than a few minutes to set up and breaks the first time my K PLUS slip looks different, I will give up and stop using it, the same way I did with the other app.
would_change_my_mind: A setup that takes about five minutes, with a step-by-step guide that works on my first K PLUS screenshot, so I can see my slips appear in the app before the trial ends.
